title: Derivative bound for a truncated Rademacher sum
statement: Let $n$ be a positive integer, let $i$ be a coordinate in the $n$-dimensional sign cube, and let $x$ be a point of that cube. The absolute value of the discrete derivative in coordinate $i$ of the truncated normalized Rademacher sum, evaluated at $x$, is at most $1/\sqrt{n}$.
hypotheses_covered: $i$ is a coordinate in the $n$-dimensional sign cube
$x$ is a point of the sign cube
